notes:
Windows 0.7.3: the white screen is fixed

Rapid minimize and restore could leave the window white. The memory-saving suspend started a short timer when minimized; if the window came back before the timer, the suspend still ran after the resume and hid the page. It now rechecks and abandons the stale suspend.

0.7.2's Npcap fix is included: Npcap installed without WinPcap-compatible mode is found.

The phone stays on 0.6.18. Windows only. The installer is unsigned; SmartScreen warns. 0.7.2 and earlier update in place.
